name: Mevabi – Auto Image Finder & Inserter
author: Mevabi

sections.description:
Mevabi lets you search millions of free images from the most popular stock photo and GIF platforms without leaving your WordPress editor.

Supported providers:

  • Unsplash
  • Pexels
  • Pixabay
  • Openverse (no API key required)
  • Giphy

Features:

  • Search images from the Classic Editor (TinyMCE) and the Block Editor (Gutenberg)
  • Insert images directly into post content
  • Set as featured image with one click
  • Auto-search using the post title
  • Configurable results per page
  • Attribution metadata saved automatically

External Services

This plugin connects to external image provider APIs in order to search and retrieve royalty-free images and GIFs selected by the user.

Services used:

  1. Pexels API
    Used to search royalty-free images.
    Data sent: Search keywords entered by the user.
    Terms of Service: https://www.pexels.com/terms-of-service/
    Privacy Policy: https://www.pexels.com/privacy-policy/

  2. Pixabay API
    Used to search royalty-free images.
    Data sent: Search keywords entered by the user.
    Terms of Service: https://pixabay.com/service/terms/
    Privacy Policy: https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/

  3. Openverse API
    Used to search openly licensed media.
    Data sent: Search keywords entered by the user.
    Terms: https://wordpress.org/openverse/
    Privacy Policy: https://automattic.com/privacy/

  4. Giphy API
    Used to search GIF images.
    Data sent: Search keywords entered by the user.
    Terms of Service: https://support.giphy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020027752-GIPHY-API-Terms-of-Service
    Privacy Policy: https://giphy.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mevabi folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Mevabi and enter your API keys for the providers you want to use.
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys for all providers?

No. Openverse works without an API key (with a reduced rate limit). All other providers require a free API key from their respective developer portals.

Where do I get API keys?

  • Unsplash: https://unsplash.com/developers
  • Pexels: https://www.pexels.com/api/
  • Pixabay: https://pixabay.com/api/docs/
  • Openverse: https://api.openverse.org/v1/
  • Giphy: https://developers.giphy.com/
